groups.activity: pledge Steel Meridian, earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.meta: 365,000 standing total to General plus the shotgun
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Protector, 3 at Rank 5 General

conditions: Rank-ups also cost 940,000 credits in total. Rank up as soon as you can afford it; standing past a rank's maximum is wasted.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to General (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). The 125,000-standing purchase is then farmed on top; General's bar holds 132,000, enough to bank it.

conditions: The free item you pick at General can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Hek is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 12 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: Vaykor Marelok and Vaykor Sydon sell from the same General rank if you want all the Steel Meridian Mastery.

disclosures.title: skip Scattered Justice
disclosures.body: The Hek augment Steel Meridian sells doesn't work on the Vaykor Hek: it already has Justice built in, and a weapon can't carry two syndicate effects.
